'''Pit Rauhut''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Along with fellow Mandalorians [[Roggar Den]] and [[Warusman Ordo]], he came to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] to participate in a challenging trial. One would inject himself with lethal poison and have approximately 30 minutes to acquire the antidote from extremely hostile [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Sand People]] nearby. Warusman Ordo was trying to prove himself the best, but in the end, the poison weakened him enough for the Sand People to finish him. Roggar Den and Pit Rauhut then ordered a passing Imperial to participate in the ritual.
